title: Affine fibre-product consequence of a finite Galois tensor decomposition
statement: Let L be a field [def-pc-field-extension], E/L a finite Galois extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] with group Q = Aut_L(E), and let phi : E tensor_L E \to product_{q in Q} E be the L-algebra isomorphism sending a tensor a tensor b to (a q(b))_q. For pi : Spec E \to Spec L [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the fibre product W = Spec E x_{Spec L} Spec E [def-pc-fibre-product] is isomorphic over Spec E (via the first projection) to the finite coproduct of copies of Spec E indexed by Q; on the q-th component the first projection is the identity and the second projection is Spec q.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite etale objects under a finite Galois extension (tensor decomposition and the resulting disjoint-union description)

proof.text: Use Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.sigmaSpec with the constant family of rings E indexed by Aut_L(E). Its finite-index IsIso instance gives the isomorphism from the coproduct of Spec E to Spec of the product ring; AlgebraicGeometry.ι_sigmaSpec identifies each component map with Spec of coordinate evaluation. This is the finite-product spectrum step directly supplied by Mathlib, without the unfinished finite-product-fields theorem.

Apply Spec to the opposite of the ring isomorphism underlying the supplied algebra isomorphism phi, giving Spec of the product ring isomorphic to Spec(E tensor_L E). Compose with the inverse of pullbackSpecIso L E E from [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. This constructs the required coproduct-to-pullback isomorphism.

For the first projection, use pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst and ι_sigmaSpec, then combine the three Spec maps using Spec.map_comp. The resulting ring homomorphism sends a to phi(a tensor 1)(q)=a q(1)=a by hphi, so it is the identity. For the second projection use pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd: the corresponding composite sends b to phi(1 tensor b)(q)=q(b), again by hphi. Ring-homomorphism extensionality and contravariant functoriality prove both required equations. No nontriviality assumption on the automorphism group is used, so this includes E=L.

lean.statement: theorem finiteGaloisTensorCoproduct (L E : Type u) [Field L] [Field E] [Algebra L E] [FiniteDimensional L E] [IsGalois L E] (φ : (E ⊗[L] E) ≃ₐ[L] ((E ≃ₐ[L] E) → E)) (hφ : ∀ (a b : E) (q : E ≃ₐ[L] E), φ (a ⊗ₜ[L] b) q = a * q b) : ∃ e : (∐ fun _ : E ≃ₐ[L] E => Spec (.of E)) ≅ pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L E))) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L E))), (∀ q : E ≃ₐ[L] E, Sigma.ι (fun _ : E ≃ₐ[L] E => Spec (.of E)) q ≫ e.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = 𝟙 (Spec (.of E))) ∧ (∀ q : E ≃ₐ[L] E, Sigma.ι (fun _ : E ≃ₐ[L] E => Spec (.of E)) q ≫ e.hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom q.toRingEquiv.toRingHom))
